resources.string: Private messaging that no one can read
Only if you already have a 24-word recovery phrase
Share your invite code. Open is free; in Tunnel you pay a setup per contact, in Shielded per message.
Only you and your contact can read your messages. The blockchain and the relays that carry them can\'t.
Shielded messages travel inside Zcash transactions. Open and Tunnel messages go free through Nostr relays, one of them run by ZChat; relays can\'t read them.
Choose how each chat travels: Shielded, inside Zcash transactions, for a little ZEC; or free through Nostr relays, which can\'t read your messages.
ZEC is optional. You can chat for free; you only need a little ZEC to send Shielded messages, which travel inside Zcash transactions.
If someone invited you, ask them to send you a small amount. 0.005 ZEC covers about 25 short Shielded messages.
ZEC is available on most crypto exchanges. Buy a small amount and send it to your address.
Deposit BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC or 20+ other tokens and swap to ZEC directly in the app. Go to Wallet tab → Swap. No account needed.
